t: AI Energy and Resources: Grid Balance Controller — Simple
name: AI Energy and Resources: Grid Balance Controller — Simple
title: AI Energy and Resources: Grid Balance Controller — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A dispatch controller that matches generation to load in 5-minute intervals. It forecasts demand from recent history, commits slow generators first, and holds fast storage for the residual. The controller's job is arithmetic, not magic: every interval must show supply equal to demand plus reserve.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Solar farm output, 10,000 m2 at 22% efficiency = 2200.0 kW. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Energy & Resources (Chapter 1)
real_world_basis: Real grid operators run exactly this stack — day-ahead commitment plus real-time economic dispatch — on every interconnected grid on Earth.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UER balance assessor — the chapter's A7 Balance (demand vs supply) scored per interval as a 0–1 index, with the scoring rule versioned and the 'universal' framing kept as an explicit Signature concept.
build_steps: Build: pick a service area, size generation to 120% of peak, provision storage for the worst ramp, then verify dispatch cost against the forecast.
math_note: Solar farm output, 10,000 m2 at 22% efficiency: 2200.0 kW [verified]; Battery bank energy, 48 V 200 Ah string x 20: 9600 Wh [verified]

math_check.label: Solar farm output, 10,000 m2 at 22% efficiency
math_check.claim: P = area x irradiance x eff / 1000

math_check.label: Battery bank energy, 48 V 200 Ah string x 20

safety: Electrical safety: dispatch software never overrides protection relays; treat every setpoint as advisory until field-verified.
how_it_works: Load forecast feeds a merit-order stack: cheapest reliable megawatts dispatch first, batteries cover ramps. The controller re-solves each interval and logs the imbalance it had to absorb. The demo recomputes a solar farm's output and a battery bank's energy from first principles.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub

t: AI Energy and Resources: Resource Extraction Scheduler — Simple
name: AI Energy and Resources: Resource Extraction Scheduler — Simple
title: AI Energy and Resources: Resource Extraction Scheduler — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A scheduler that plans extraction against regeneration so a resource is never mined past its maximum sustainable yield. It tracks stock, applies the logistic growth rate, and caps each period's take at the computed MSY. Extraction above the cap is flagged, not executed.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Maximum sustainable yield, r=0.4, K=1,000,000 = 100000 units/period. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Energy & Resources (Chapter 1)
real_world_basis: Maximum sustainable yield scheduling is standard practice in fisheries, forestry, and groundwater management worldwide.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UER Totality assessor — the chapter's A7 Totality (extraction vs regeneration) as a computed ratio per period, with the 'universal resource' framing labeled concept and the quota itself real.
build_steps: Build: survey the stock, fit the logistic rate, publish the quota, then meter actual takes against it.
math_note: Maximum sustainable yield, r=0.4, K=1,000,000: 100000 units/period [verified]; Logistic increment, N=600,000 of K=1,000,000: 96000 units/period [verified]

math_check.label: Maximum sustainable yield, r=0.4, K=1,000,000
Logistic increment, N=600,000 of K=1,000,000

safety: Ecological safety: never set a quota from a single survey; require three consecutive agreeing estimates before raising any cap.
how_it_works: Stock surveys feed the logistic model; the scheduler converts the growth rate into a per-period quota and distributes it across sites by cost. The demo recomputes MSY and the logistic increment for a fishery-style stock.

t: AI Energy and Resources: Demand Response Coordinator — Simple
name: AI Energy and Resources: Demand Response Coordinator — Simple
title: AI Energy and Resources: Demand Response Coordinator — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A coordinator that shaves peaks by shifting flexible loads instead of firing peaker plants. It ranks loads by shiftability, sends curtailment signals with a price, and verifies each response against metered data. Every megawatt shifted is metered, never assumed.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Signal entropy for a 2-state curtailment signal at p=0.7 = 0.8813 bits/signal. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Energy & Resources (Chapter 1)
real_world_basis: Demand response programs operate at gigawatt scale in North America, Europe, and parts of Asia.
signature_version: Signature version: the AI-UER First/Last assessor — the chapter's A7 First (trigger) and Last (settlement) events logged per curtailment round, with the framing labeled concept and the metered megawatts real.
build_steps: Build: enroll flexible loads first, prove the signal path, then bid the aggregated curtailment into the peak window.
math_note: Signal entropy for a 2-state curtailment signal at p=0.7: 0.8813 bits/signal [verified]; Shannon capacity of a 5 MHz signal link at SNR 7: 15.00 Mbps [verified]

math_check.label: Signal entropy for a 2-state curtailment signal at p=0.7
Shannon capacity of a 5 MHz signal link at SNR 7

safety: Consumer safety: curtailment contracts must exempt medical and life-safety loads explicitly, in writing, before enrollment.
how_it_works: Price signals go out ahead of the peak; enrolled loads respond on contract; meters confirm. The coordinator's ledger matches signaled curtailment against measured drop, and the demo recomputes the channel capacity the signal network needs.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
